note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a UKR 9; A06b UKR 9; L05 UKR 2(1), 19(1), Law on occupied territories April 15, 2014 No. 1207-VII): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. On 18 June 2025 the Verkhovna Rada adopted Bill 11469 introducing multiple citizenship for designated countries, whose list the Cabinet of Ministers sets (Rubryka, 18 June 2025): their nationals naturalise in Ukraine on simplified terms, and Ukrainians may take their citizenship. For everyone else the renunciation and loss above stand; the designated countries' exception isn't modelled. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Ukraine, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Ukraine for 5 years uninterrupted. Permit to immigrate required. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. No renunciation required if citizenship is lost on the basis of an international agreement. Declaration of renunciation suffices if person is a refugee or performed outstanding services. Declaration of renunciation suffices if person performs military service under a contract in the Armed Forces of Ukraine, is a citizen of an aggressor state or occupying state and has experienced persecution, or is a spouse of such a person. ... Person has voluntarily acquired foreign citizenship after the age of 18. Loss cannot result in statelessness. Persons living in the temporarily occupied territories (Crimea) and who automatically acquired the citizenship of the Russian Federation do not lose Ukrainian citizenship. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Ukraine to a citizen. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born abroad to a citizen. ... No provision ... No provision

sources.title: Rubryka, Verkhovna Rada passes law allowing multiple citizenship (18 June 2025)
sources.said: On June 18, the Verkhovna Rada adopted the law to introduce the institution of multiple citizenship in Ukraine. ... The criteria for countries and citizens who have the right to acquire Ukrainian citizenship will be determined by the Cabinet of Ministers,
